name: Rabbitgoo No-Pull Dog Harness
pick: Measure the chest just behind the front legs and choose the size that puts that number mid-range. A 50-lb Jindo lands in Large.

name: KONG Classic (natural rubber, made in the USA)
pick: Large for 30–65 lb dogs (Noeul's size). Between sizes, go up, never down; power chewers get the black Extreme.

name: Earth Rated Dog Poop Bags (270, unscented, refill rolls)
pick: 270-count unscented on refill rolls (15 a roll, fits any dispenser); add the leash dispenser once, not every time.

name: Higgsfield (the rendering half: images, video, the MCP connector)
pick: The smallest plan is enough to learn on; move up only when the plan step is producing shots you keep. Never buy annual before one month of real use.

name: Claude (the planning half: shot list, prompts, review)
pick: Pro is the practical floor: long conversations, photo uploads, and custom connectors. Max only if you batch dozens of jobs a day.

name: ElevenLabs (the voice that turns a silent clip into an ad)
pick: Starter for a few ads a month; Creator when you dub or run more than about ten minutes of speech a month.

name: Foldable photo light box, 12–16 inch (with LED strips)
pick: A 16-inch box fits a shoebox-sized product; 12-inch is enough for bottles and gadgets.

name: Phone tripod with a ball head and remote
pick: Any 50–60 inch tripod with a ball head; the remote matters more than the brand.

name: Portable SSD, 1–2 TB (USB-C)
pick: 2 TB if you keep everything; 1 TB if you cull.

name: Levoit Core 300-P Air Purifier
pick: Core 300-P in white (the black one does the same job); one Original 3-in-1 filter is already inside the base

name: Levoit Core 300-RF Replacement Filter (genuine Original 3-in-1)
